title: Dragon Ch0nk Rebirth: Core
description: Adds several custom items & dimensions that are needed for the Dragon Ch0nk Rebirth minecraft server.
body:
This mod is meant to be used on the Dragon Ch0nk Rebirth official server. It adds several features required to fufill the multiplayer experience.
## Current Features:
- Hakaishin Planet: A dimension with huge trees, blue grass, and a red sky.
- Divine Wood
